caption:
A lot of managers hide behind “we” when the call is really theirs.

It sounds safer. It also makes people feel handled instead of told the truth.

Try the clear line: “I’ve decided not to approve vacation next week.” Then give the reason, without hiding.

What’s a work sentence you’ve used because it felt safer than saying “I” ?

#newmanager #leadership #management

slides.headline: It hides the <u>decision</u>.
slides.sub: They don’t know who decided, and it can sound slippery.

slides.label: Say this
slides.quote: “I’ve decided not to approve vacation next week.”

slides.headline: Own the hard <u>call</u>.
slides.sub: Clear is kinder than hiding behind “we.”

slides.headline: Say it out loud before you say it for real.
slides.sub: Steady lets you practice the hard conversation first.
